texts.text: Projects
Research projects and proposal development in infrastructure digitalisation, intelligent engineering, and bridge earthquake engineering.
Doctoral Research & Independent Proposals
Knowledge-guided Scan-to-BIM for Reinforced Concrete Bridges
Developing engineering knowledge-guided point cloud segmentation and occlusion-aware completion methods for the digital reconstruction of reinforced concrete girder bridges.
The University of Auckland · Supervisors: Professor Yang Zou and Dr Enrique del Rey Castillo
BridgeAgent-DT
Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent Digital Twins for Bridge Management.
Applicant and proposal lead for a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Postdoctoral Fellowship application, with University College London as the proposed host institution.
BIM- and UAV-Integrated Intelligent Bridge Inspection System
Doctoral scholarship research proposal hosted by the University of Auckland. Independently prepared the scholarship application and research proposal.
